description: workflow/04_real_data.smk (experiment C): public data sets, their sources and the preprocessing applied by python/sharedimp_exp/real_data.py. Selection criteria and the reasons for each choice are in docs/experiment_plan.md, section 5.
standardize: every feature is centred and divided by its standard deviation (all rows, ddof = 1); predictions of the learners used here (unpenalized linear models, forests) do not depend on an affine rescaling of a feature, so this only conditions the optimisers

concrete.title: Concrete Compressive Strength
concrete.citation: Yeh, I-C. (1998). Concrete Compressive Strength [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository.

wdbc.title: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic), the ten mean features
wdbc.citation: Wolberg, W., Mangasarian, O., Street, N., & Street, W. (1993). Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic) [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository.

maternal.title: Maternal Health Risk
maternal.citation: Ahmed, M. (2020). Maternal Health Risk [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository.

penguins.title: Palmer penguins (complete cases of the four measurements)
penguins.citation: Horst, A. M., Hill, A. P., & Gorman, K. B. (2020). palmerpenguins: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) penguin data. R package version 0.1.0.

separation_rule: a classification data set is used only if unpenalized (multinomial) logistic regression on the standardized features misclassifies at least one training row in every training fold, i.e. the maximum-likelihood estimate exists; otherwise it is recorded as rejected and no file is written
